Watch the energetic “Naari Naari” video song from the Telugu movie Aagadu, starring Mahesh Babu and Tamannaah Bhatia. The song features the energetic music of Thaman S.
Movie Details:
Movie: Aagadu
Starring: Super Star Mahesh Babu, Tamannaah Bhatia, Sonu Sood, Brahmanandam, Rajendra Prasad
Music Director: Thaman S
Director: Sreenu Vaitla
Producer: 14 Reels Entertainment
Music Label: Lahari Music
